limitations: Organism-level agreement in 62 residual BALF specimens from lower respiratory tract infection; not plasma cell-free DNA and not patient-level diagnosis.

The two workflows differ in platform, library preparation, host depletion, aligner and positivity threshold together (MGISEQ-200 with BWA-MEM and RP20M >= 3; host-depleted ONT GridION with minimap2 and RP10K >= 1), so the comparison is of whole workflows, not of classifiers.

Eight of the listed authors, including co-corresponding author Lifeng Li, are affiliated with Genskey Medical Technology (Beijing), a clinical mNGS provider; the article states that the authors declare no conflict of interest. The workflows are the authors' own, so the evaluations are author_reported.

attributes.protocol: Runs N’ Poses receptor–ligand co-folding; source benchmark 2,600 systems. Figure 2C reports n=2,573 scored ligands on the intersection where all models produced valid predictions, after excluding undefined SuCOS scores. Multiple ligands in one system are scored independently. Five seeds × five diffusion samples per target; select top candidate by ipTM. Success requires lDDT-PLI >0.8 and BiSyRMSD <2 angstrom. Exploratory comparison: prior results were known. Paired contrast intervals are unadjusted and do not establish a universal model ranking.

Precision at 100 is sensitive to tied-score ordering, especially P1. Numerical source checking is automated, not human review or independent reproduction.
Assembly-orientation issue reported at https://github.com/KosuriLab/MFASS/issues/1. Original v1 outputs remain unchanged; corrections require a new version.

comparison.population: Reads synthesised with bbtools randomreads.sh from seven genomes (four Genomoviridae, three Picornaviridae) at 75.91% to 95.62% ANI to their closest database reference, at 1, 10, 100 and 1,000 reads, ten permutations per depth
comparison.inputs: Synthetic read pairs (bbtools randomreads.sh)
comparison.adaptation: Headline setting: minimum-hit-length 100, minimum score 0

limitations: Run by the developers of EsViritu, who chose each comparator's parameter grid and headline setting.

description: Published calibration; transcribed, not reproduced.

comparison.population: 11,834 missense variants from 1,914 genes; prior probability of pathogenicity 4.41% (gnomAD set)

comparison.aggregation: Pooled over variants in all genes
